name: @hhmi/proofig-pdf-service-cloudrun
description: Bundled Proofig PDF service (Cloud Run deployment shell)

scripts.build:service: cd ../../packages/proofig-pdf-service && npm run build && cd ../.. && cp packages/proofig-pdf-service/dist/* services/proofig-pdf-cloudrun && cd services/proofig-pdf-cloudrun
scripts.build:local: npm run build:service && docker build --tag proofig-pdf-local .
